Her acute sensitivity to sound makes her excellent at search and detection, but also overly susceptible to loud noises, which she detests.

lines.text:
I'm only with you right now for Mother's sake.
Don't delude yourself into thinking I'm actually on your side.
There's a lot of noise around you, Human. But I like how quiet you are.
*Yawn* It's strange. Being next to you makes me sleepy.

You're quiet, Human. Like the deep sea.
That's why being with you... isn't all that unpleasant.

It's comfortable being next to you... which is dangerous.
But I'll stay with you, for now.
So long as you don't pose a threat to Mother, I'll let you live.
If we're not gonna do anything, I'd rather go somewhere else. It's too noisy here!

Don't talk to me, Human. I'm enjoying this silence.
*Yawn* I think I might finally sleep soundly for once.
It's a little noisy here but... it's not unbearable.
It's so peaceful here. This calm reminds me of you, Human.
Hmm... not a bad place to just float around. I'm gonna take a catnap now.
I'll look after you, Human... until your calm begins to falter.
I've gotten stronger... yet everything feels even more annoying now.
So this is... the humans' enhancement technology...
You want to see how strong I am? How troublesome...
These... must've been a hassle to get.
You want to see me happy? Why...?
I can see right through your intentions, but nevertheless... I'm happy.
Since you're not the annoying type, I'll stick by your side a little longer.
I sleep like a baby whenever you're near. So stay by my side, Human.
It's so strange, Human. I'm starting to like your tranquility more and more.
I'm feeling a little lazy... but I'll tag along.
*Yawn*
Let's go.
Ugh, what a hassle...
Don't expect me to give it my all.
I'm taking a nap... you take charge.
Ugh, I'm gonna get rid of anything that makes noise.
Ugh... I'm going back to sleep... Figure it out yourself.
Ugh... All right... Need a recharge.
Ugh... So annoying... Don't wake me up...
Get ready, Human.
Hell has no fury like a woman awoken!
You're all getting on my nerves.
*Yawn*
Yeah, yeah... Good job.
It's not over yet...
Ahh...
Leave me alone...
Ugh...
That's enough for now. I'm tapped out.
We've won. Happy now?
A life where everyone can live together in peace... That would be nice, if it were possible.
Do you think we'll ever be able to understand each other...?
The world I long for is always in my dreams, so I want to sleep a little deeper, a little longer.
Lately, I've been having nice dreams. You're at the center of them, and everyone's happy, just enjoying their time together.
I feel like having a normal conversation. What do you like, Human?
I'm counting on you to open up new possibilities. I hope you'll come through for me.
Where did you go, Human? We're not done talking.
I guess waiting can be a kind of conversation too. All right, I'll wait.
If I fall asleep here, I might have sweeter dreams.
Everyone looks so happy. It would seem you've already achieved peace here.
*Yawn...* I'm going to sleep. Don't feel the need to wake me...
This feels warm and calm, like I'm drifting through a dream.
If getting stronger helps our conversation, then I am happy with it...
Mmm... I'm starting to feel sleepier.
Yeah, I'll help you. That way... we can understand each other.
I feel better now. Maybe sharing things like this is its own kind of conversation.
I don't know what to use this for, but... I'll hang onto it.
Will I have better dreams if I sleep with this...?
You have to be part of the world I dream of, Human.
When I'm with you, I feel like I could dream sweet dreams every day...
It looks like I made the right choice... I'm glad I met you.
Mmm... okay.
Zzzzz...
Mmm, mmm...
I was having such a good dream...
If we can't talk this out, then so be it.
All of you... come into my dream.
I'll end this quickly.
Give me a second to wake up...
*Yawn...* I need a nap...
... All that matters is you're safe.
*Yawn* I'm sleepy.
Good night. Sweet dreams.
It's time to wake up.
Quiet down...
Are we done yet...?
I'm bored...
Argh...
Ugh...
Hm...
This isn't what my dream looked like...
That was a satisfying dream.
